items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: He picked that jazz up from Rudy Vallee. I saw when he made the change. We used to do broadcasts or something, and Rudy Vallee one day... There was a place where Rudy Vallee was rehearsing his band.

ctx.x: to be the star in the show, and he had to show his authority that this was his... He knew it was his band, but he just wasn't in it at that time. I had charge of it, and I knew it! And he heckled us a couple of times. I bawled him out in front of the whole show. I just laid him out. And I said, 'Man, leave us alone. We know what we're doing.' He shut up, too. He knew he was wrong, but he was just nervous. But I did have the sense to go back later and apologize. Because I'm bawling my boss out! But he just didn't…

He picked that jazz up from Rudy Vallee. I saw when he made the change. We used to do broadcasts or something, and Rudy Vallee one day... There was a place where Rudy Vallee was rehearsing his band. And he was making big money. And oh, he just got an opportunity to bawl the guys out. And he was giving them the devil...
